_release_policy_verbatim.quote: Currently releases are not published to github releases, only nightly/development builds are available there.
_release_policy_verbatim.note: 即 bXXXXX 全部是 nightly/development build，官方明确声明它们不是正式 release。这一点决定了本case study 的性质：不是验「正式发布说明对不对」，而是验「nightly 公告的承诺与实际产物是否对得上」。
